name: DCA Lucky Fortune Cookery Beef Bulgogi Burrito or Rice Bowl (Hold Spicy Sauce/Chips Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Lucky Fortune Cookery (San Fransokyo Square · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Tender sweet-savory Korean bulgogi beef and garlic rice wrapped in a warm flour tortilla, though you should ask to hold the spicy gochujang mayo and cabbage slaw.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for no spicy mayo and no raw cabbage slaw—or stick to the simpler Teriyaki Chicken & White Rice bowl on sensitive days.
watchOuts: Default Beef Bulgogi Burrito includes spicy mayo, raw cabbage slaw, and crunchy garlic chips
